fieldData.full-article-text:
All Instabridge users are required to have an Instapass ID. 

As we are both receiving and sending tokens directly to individuals, we are required to comply with the UK and EU rules on financial transfers. This means all Instabridge users must first have completed identity checks, known as Know Your Customer (KYC), before we can send back XRD tokens.

Once a user has passed KYC through Instapass, they will have the option to share that data with DeFi and other services rather than repeating the same steps.

For our full guide on how to create your Instapass ID, please see here.
fieldData.name: Why do I need an Instapass account to use Instabridge?
